findings.reason: a builder that follows the opening clause writes the renewal into the registration record, whose cross-node half-written read §8 gives as exactly why the lease must be a separate, atomically-replaced file, so the record a foreign reader must parse for its host goes unreadable and the follower reads gone again — the defect the section exists to remove.
findings.text: §8's deliverable opens "judged by a lease the follower renews in its own registration record", but three sentences later the same paragraph says "The renewal cannot go in the registration itself" and puts it in "a lease file beside its registration", replaced atomically by rename; the two statements name opposite homes for the lease, and the body's own reason (an in-place registration write is read half-written by another node that cannot take the lock to serialise) is the reason the record cannot hold it
